description: AzAHP practitioner data form page 2: the main fillable form, a dense grid of boxed fields with 34 text boxes and 59 checkboxes (YES/NO pairs, Group Type, Practitioner Type, Lines of Business, special-needs and diagnosis groups).

contains_in_order: PLEASE TYPE OR PRINT CLEARLY AND COMPLETE THIS FORM IN ITS ENTIRETY

field_group.legend: Do you provide services to individuals with special needs/chronic conditions? (check all that apply)

assertions.xfail: The 'Post the following items' group holds only two of its four checkboxes: 'Documentation of board certification or scheduled exam date' and the dental 'General Anesthesia Permit, Conscious Sedation Permit and/or Oral Conscious Sedation Permit' are outside the fieldset.

field_group.legend: Post the following items (as applicable) to CAQH-Please check box(es) to indicate items posted:
options: Documentation of board certification or scheduled exam date
Medicaid required insurance certificates as applicable (see page 3 for requirements)
General Anesthesia Permit, Conscious Sedation Permit and/or Oral Conscious Sedation Permit

assertions.xfail: The Patient Gender group has no legend and is missing the 'Male' checkbox: it holds only 'Female' and 'All'.

The diagnoses checkboxes and the PCP/OBGYN services checkboxes run together in one unlabeled group of ten (Anxiety ... None, EPSDT, OB, None); the question 'Do you treat any of the following diagnoses?' is not its legend.
